run_image_caption_retrieval: run image caption retrieval evaluation on COCO dataset using trained embeddings
load_coco_data: load COCO dataset pickle files for train, valid, and test splits with captions and image features
prepare_sentence_embeddings: prepare all sentence samples from train, dev, and test splits for embedding computation
compute_image_text_embeddings: compute sentence and image embeddings for image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval ranking
evaluate_retrieval_ranking: evaluate image-caption retrieval with recall@1, recall@5, recall@10, and median rank metrics
